import z3
import itertools
points = list(range(15))
all_blocks = list(itertools.combinations(points, 3))
solver = z3.Solver()
y = {b: z3.Int(f"y_{b[0]}_{b[1]}_{b[2]}") for b in all_blocks}
for var in y.values():
    solver.add(var >= 0)
    solver.add(var <= 1)
for p in itertools.combinations(points, 2):
    containing = [b for b in all_blocks if set(p).issubset(b)]
    solver.add(z3.Sum([y[b] for b in containing]) == 3)
for p in points:
    containing = [b for b in all_blocks if p in b]
    solver.add(z3.Sum([y[b] for b in containing]) == 21)
print("Constraints added, starting check...")
result = solver.check()
print(result)
